mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_location_inventory WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT l.location_code FROM wms_location_inventory i JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.quantity > 0 OR i.reserved_quantity > 0) ORDER BY l.location_code

SELECT DISTINCT i.wms_tenant_id FROM wms_location_inventory i JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.rack_no = #{rackNo} AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.quantity > 0 OR i.reserved_quantity > 0)
